components.label: Buttons
components.role: The site's buttons. One component, three emphasis levels. Every colour comes from the token contract, so a brand pack restyles them without touching this code.

components.label: Header
components.role: The site chrome's top bar: one configuration, injected on every page by the same script. Whatever pack the site is wearing restyles it — the nav never carries a brand value of its own.

components.label: Footer
components.role: The site chrome's other half: the site index and the contact line, injected on every page from the same configuration as the header, and restyled by whichever pack is worn.

components.label: Cards
components.role: The site's surface cards. Background, border, text and spacing all resolve through named tokens, so the same card looks native under any brand pack.

components.label: Decision card (organism)
components.role: One decision from a real project write-up: the call, and the reasoning under it. An accented left edge and a surface that both come from the token contract, so the card reads native under any brand pack.

components.label: Page hero
components.role: The site's cover: one claim and two actions. Every colour and size on it resolves through the token contract, so a different pack redresses the whole band without touching its markup.

components.label: ds-metric-tile — cross-scenario library primitive
components.role: One computed metric: a label, a value, an optional unit. The library's cross-scenario primitive for answering "how many". Both demo scenarios and /build's dashboard pattern render through it.

components.label: ds-list-row — cross-scenario library primitive
components.role: One named entity per row, with a figure and an optional status. The library primitive for answering "which ones". Queues, feeds and settings on /build all render through it.

components.label: ds-sequence-step — cross-scenario library primitive
components.role: One position in an ordered sequence: number, name, optional qualifier. The library primitive for answering "where in the order". /build's onboarding pattern repeats it.

components.label: vd-screen-header
components.role: The Verdant phone app bar: back affordance, screen title, settings. Part of the fictional plant-care demo, and always the topmost element of a screen.

components.label: vd-status-chip
components.role: A small pill naming a plant's care state in the Verdant demo, its one categorical state signal. Always a child of a card or row, never free-standing.

components.label: vd-plant-card
components.role: One plant in Verdant's "My plants" list: thumbnail, name and species, status chip. The whole card is one tap target.

components.label: vd-stat-tile
components.role: One sensor reading on a Verdant plant screen: value and unit large, glyph and caption quiet. It displays; urgency is the status chip's job.

components.label: vd-care-task-row
components.role: One scheduled care action in Verdant's "Today" list: a check circle, the action, a status chip. One action per row.

components.label: vd-primary-button
components.role: The Verdant screen's one committing action: a full-width accent button, always last in reading order. On the today screen it logs the checked care tasks.

components.label: fw-* — Fieldwork dispatch-board chrome (human-fixed canvas)
components.role: The dispatch board's human-designed chrome in the fictional Fieldwork demo: the toolbar, the job panels, the technician lanes. It is the fixed half of a hybrid canvas; the two agentic slots compose inside it, never over it.
